description.value: Pho Quynh Express (Yaletown) is one of three Vancouver locations of a Vietnamese noodle chain serving pho, vermicelli bowls, rice dishes, and spring rolls, with menu items in Vietnamese, English, and Chinese. The Yaletown outpost sits on Pacific Boulevard and offers both dine-in and online pickup ordering. Its broad Southeast Asian menu — spanning Vietnamese, Thai, and Cambodian flavours — makes it a practical mid-ride fuel stop in a busy urban cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Yaletown location of a three-location chain, matching the OSM phone number (+1 604-336-0558) and street number (1263), but the street name differs: OSM says 'Pacific Street' while the website consistently says 'Pacific Blvd' with postal code V6Z2R6. The website's Yaletown location page confirms pickup/takeout ('Order Now Pickup 15 min') but contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so all such fields default to null.
